import z3

weeks = 7
golfers = 32
groups_per_week = 8
group_size = 4

# Create solver
s = z3.Solver()

# Variables: group[w][g]
group = [[z3.Int(f'g{w}_{g}') for g in range(golfers)] for w in range(weeks)]

# Constraints
for w in range(weeks):
    for g in range(golfers):
        s.add(group[w][g] >= 0, group[w][g] < groups_per_week)
    
    for grp in range(groups_per_week):
        s.add(z3.Sum([z3.If(group[w][g] == grp, 1, 0) for g in range(golfers)]) == group_size)

# Pair constraints: at most one week together
for p1 in range(golfers):
    for p2 in range(p1+1, golfers):
        together = [z3.If(group[w][p1] == group[w][p2], 1, 0) for w in range(weeks)]
        s.add(z3.Sum(together) <= 1)

print(s.check())
